description: MonkeyMode guardrail preset: Unreal Engine 5 C++ under Source/. Comments stay allowed (noComments false) because Unreal turns UPROPERTY/UFUNCTION comments into editor tooltips. Partly checked against the Unreal Engine 5.9 docs.

rules.message: Creating UObjects or Actors with raw new is banned. The garbage collector does not know about them, reflection data is missing and they crash on collection. Use NewObject<T>(Outer), CreateDefaultSubobject<T>() in constructors, or GetWorld()->SpawnActor<T>().
Deleting UObjects is banned. The garbage collector owns them. Call Actor->Destroy(), Component->DestroyComponent(), or drop the last UPROPERTY reference.

Raw UObject pointer members are banned in headers. Without UPROPERTY the GC can collect the object and leave a dangling pointer. Declare UPROPERTY() TObjectPtr<UType> Member; (TWeakObjectPtr for non-owning references). If this line is inside a function body, move it to the .cpp.

World-wide actor searches are banned at runtime. They are O(actors), and they depend on spawn and streaming order. Register actors with a subsystem (UWorldSubsystem) on BeginPlay and query that, or pass references explicitly.

Synchronous loads at runtime are banned. They hitch the game thread and hide hard asset dependencies. Use TSoftObjectPtr with the AssetManager / FStreamableManager async loads, or a hard UPROPERTY reference when the asset is always needed.

std::thread and std::async are banned. They bypass Unreal's task graph and are unsafe with UObjects. Use UE::Tasks::Launch, Async(EAsyncExecution::ThreadPool, ...), FRunnable, or AsyncTask(ENamedThreads::GameThread, ...) to get back to the game thread.
Sleeping blocks the calling thread; on the game thread it freezes the game and the server. Use FTimerManager timers, latent actions, or a task.
UE_LOG(LogTemp, ...) is banned. Agents judge behavior from logs and need a category per module. Declare DECLARE_LOG_CATEGORY_EXTERN(Log<Module>, Log, All) and use it.

On-screen debug messages are banned in shipped code paths. They cannot be checked from logs and leak into builds. Log with a category; draw debug only behind a console variable in non-shipping builds.

Global time dilation is banned in networked games: server and client time drift and movement correction fights it. Pause through game state on the server. Remove this rule for single-player games (user approval).
